name: Permanent Resident Status (Immigration Act, Cap. 190, Section 5)

requirement_groups.name: 5 years' continuous residence as an Immigrant

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 5 years' continuous residence in Barbados while holding Immigrant Status.
requirements.fix_path: Continue residing in Barbados under Immigrant Status until the 5-year threshold is reached.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse of a person who is a citizen of Barbados by birth or by descent. (The Act's own wording, as extracted from the consolidated statute, refers specifically to 'the husband of' a female citizen -- this may reflect genuinely gendered original drafting or a gap in the extracted text; not independently resolved in this pass.)

value.note: Nationals of CARICOM Member States upon whom the relevant Order has been conferred become permanent residents immediately, along with spouses and minor children, without application fees.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being a national of a CARICOM Member State upon whom the Order has been conferred.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate, valid passport, marriage certificate if applicable, divorce/death documentation if a previous marriage ended
Certificate of Character from the police of every country lived in for 6+ months in the past 3 years
Medical clearance (standard form for 16+, general certificate for 16 and under)
4 passport photos (1 certified by a Justice of the Peace or Notary Public), employment letter, proof of qualifications

sources.title: Barbados Judiciary (barbadoslawcourts.gov.bb) -- Immigration Act, Cap. 190, Section 5(2)
Barbados Immigration Department (immigration.gov.bb) -- requirements for permanent resident status (document checklist)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Barbados' initial build. THIS ROUTE IS THE SAME NAMED STATUS reached via three genuinely different grounds -- modelled as OR-logic groups rather than three fake separate routes, per this dataset's core structural principle. A fourth ground in the Act -- permanent residence for a person born outside Barbados to a woman who is a citizen of Barbados by birth, 'subject to constitutional limitations' -- was deliberately NOT encoded as a group here: the source text itself flags an unresolved limitation on this provision, and building a requirement group around an unclear constitutional carve-out would risk asserting eligibility that doesn't reliably exist. Treat this as a genuine gap, not an oversight, and revisit if the constitutional limitation can be pinned down. leads_to_citizenship is true, but citizenship_after_months is deliberately left null rather than guessed: full naturalisation eligibility is governed by a separate aggregate-residence test under the Citizenship Act (see bb_naturalisation), which does not simply add a fixed number of months on top of gaining PR. pr_after_months is 0 for this route's own outcome (PR is the outcome itself); the real wait, where one applies, is modelled on bb_immigrant_status's pr_after_months (60) and the prerequisites_override on the via_immigrant_status group here. The immigration.gov.bb Permanent Residence page lists required documents but not eligibility criteria -- those came entirely from the Act itself (cap190_immigration_act), which is why it is listed first.
